details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a downturn as U.S. August Producer Price Index (PPI) data exceeded expectations, rising to 5.4% year-over-year. This, coupled with Brent crude oil prices surpassing $107 per barrel, intensified expectations for a 25 basis point Federal Reserve rate hike. Bitcoin fell below $77,000, trading around $76,700, while Ethereum hovered near $2,440. Approximately $500 million in crypto positions were liquidated within 24 hours, predominantly long positions. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded around $120 million in net outflows, though Ethereum and Solana ETFs saw some net inflows.
title: Crypto Markets Under Pressure Amid Macroeconomic Headwinds

details: Bitwise has announced the closure of its Dogecoin exchange-traded fund (ETF), ticker BWOW, less than a year after its launch. Trading for the ETF is scheduled to cease on October 14, 2026. This move is reportedly part of an effort to streamline the firm's product offerings.
title: Bitwise Shuts Down Dogecoin ETF

details: Senate Republicans have released an updated version of the CLARITY Act, a legislative proposal aimed at providing regulatory clarity for the crypto industry. A procedural vote on the bill is set for September 15. The revised text includes adjustments regarding how it will address crypto activities of decentralized finance (DeFi) firms and traditional financial institutions, potentially requiring non-decentralized protocols to register with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC).
title: Senate Republicans Unveil Revised Crypto Bill

details: Blockstream has successfully recovered 3,400 BTC, representing 85% of the Bitcoin stolen from its Liquid Network. The company refused a ransom demand from the hackers, who have been described as "delusional, greedy, and arrogant." Approximately 598.5 BTC remains missing, and Blockstream intends to involve law enforcement and forensic specialists.
title: Blockstream Recovers Significant Bitcoin from Liquid Network Hack

details: Jack Dorsey's Block Inc. has applied to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) for a national trust bank charter to launch "Builders Bank." This new entity aims to provide secure custody and fiduciary services specifically for Bitcoin and stablecoins under federal supervision. The move signifies a growing trend among major financial firms to integrate digital assets into regulated banking structures.
title: Block Inc. Files for Federal Crypto Custody Bank

details: Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI), the country's banking regulator, has clarified that tokenized deposits should be treated identically to traditional deposits by federally regulated financial institutions. This technology-neutral approach focuses on the nature of the product rather than the underlying infrastructure, providing regulatory clarity for banks exploring blockchain-based payments and settlements.
title: Canada Clarifies Regulatory Stance on Tokenized Deposits

details: The XRP Ledger is implementing a bundle of 11 fixes on September 11, 2026. These updates address various aspects of the network, including savings vaults, lending tools, and built-in trading functionalities. The changes were approved through a validator vote, with strong support.
title: XRP Ledger Undergoes Key Fixes
